continue_on_error.description: Continue running setup steps after a failed step.

inputs.description: Reusable runtime input definitions resolved from --set overrides or declared default values.

execution.description: Controls how setup operations are applied and how failures are handled.

space.description: Optional target-space creation or duplication settings. Omit create_new and duplicate_from when targeting an existing space with --space-id.

preview.description: Configures the default preview URL and optional frontend environments.

demo_mode.description: Controls removal of Storyblok demo/example mode from the target space.

workflow.description: Assigns a workflow stage to stories that currently have no workflow stage.

apps.description: Installs Storyblok apps by slug or structured slug/ID reference.

ai.description: Configures Storyblok AI availability and organization-level AI configuration inheritance.

ai_translation.description: Configures the disclaimer required for the AI Translations app.

folders.description: Ensures configured folders exist, resolving them by full slug.

stories.description: Applies configured story operations. Currently supports moving selected root-level stories and folders.

dimensions.description: Reconciles folders configured for the Storyblok Dimensions app while preserving unmanaged folders.

assets.description: Uploads assets discovered in local directories relative to the setup configuration file.

components.description: Creates or updates explicitly configured fields on existing components.

tags.description: Assigns and merges tags on selected stories.

inputs.description: Map of input names to runtime input definitions.

inputDefinition.description: Defines a reusable value that can be overridden with --set NAME=VALUE.

required.description: Require a default value or matching --set override.

secret.description: Marks the input as sensitive metadata. Complete masking of secret inputs is not yet implemented.

default.description: Default input value used when no matching --set override is provided.

execution.description: Setup execution behavior. Reconcile mode preserves unmanaged resources and never removes omitted resources.

mode.description: Execution mode. Only reconcile is supported and it is the default.

continue_on_error.description: Continue running later setup operations after a failed operation while still returning a failed setup result.

space.description: Defines how the target space is created or duplicated before provisioning.

name.description: Name for a newly created or duplicated space. Required with create_new: true or duplicate_from.

create_new.description: Explicitly create a blank space before applying setup. Cannot be combined with duplicate_from or --space-id.

duplicate_from.description: Existing source space ID to duplicate before applying setup. Cannot be combined with create_new or --space-id.

in_org.description: Create the duplicated space inside the current organization.

demo.description: Mark the newly created or duplicated space as a demo/example space.

readiness.description: Polling settings used after duplication while waiting for Storyblok background tasks to complete.

spaceReadiness.description: Controls readiness polling after space duplication.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait for duplicated-space background tasks to complete.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Number of seconds to wait between duplicated-space readiness checks.

preview.description: Desired preview URL configuration. Configured environments are reconciled by name and unmanaged environments are preserved.

enabled.description: Apply preview URL configuration when true.

default.description: Default preview URL for the target space.

environments.description: Additional frontend preview environments reconciled by name.

name.description: Frontend environment display name used as the reconciliation key.

url.description: Preview URL for this frontend environment.

remove.description: Remove demo/example mode when the target space is currently marked as demo.

workflow.description: Workflow assignment configuration for stories without a workflow stage.

assign_unstaged.description: Assign a workflow stage to every story that currently has no stage.

stage_id.description: Workflow stage ID to assign. When null or omitted, blokctl uses the default workflow's first stage when available.

apps.description: App installation configuration. Already-installed apps are skipped.

continue_on_error.description: Continue installing later apps after one app installation fails.

install.description: Apps to install. Each item can be an app slug string or a structured reference containing slug, id, or both.

appReference.description: Structured app reference. Slug is resolved first; id is used as fallback only when that slug is not found.

slug.description: Storyblok app slug used for lookup and installed-app reconciliation.

id.description: Storyblok app ID used for reconciliation and as fallback when the configured slug is not found.

ai.description: Storyblok AI space configuration. Only explicitly declared settings are updated.

enabled.description: Enable or disable Storyblok AI text generation for the space.

inherit_org_configuration.description: Inherit the organization's AI configuration for this space.

disclaimer_id.description: Storyblok disclaimer ID required to activate AI Translation capabilities for the space.

ensure.description: Folders to create or reuse. Entries run in declaration order so later entries can reference earlier parents.

folderDefinition.description: Desired folder resolved by its full slug.

name.description: Folder display name used when the folder must be created.

slug.description: Expected full folder slug used to find and reconcile the folder.

parent_slug.description: Full slug of the parent folder. Omit to create or reconcile a root-level folder.

move.description: Root-content move operations applied in declaration order.

storyMove.description: Moves selected root-level content into a target folder.

select.description: Selector defining which root-level content should be moved.

to_folder.description: Full slug of the target folder.

storyMoveSelector.description: Selects root-level stories and optionally folders. Excluded slugs remain at root.

parent.description: Source parent selector. Currently only root-level content is supported.

include_folders.description: Include root-level folders in addition to stories.

include_slugs.description: When provided, move only items whose local slug is in this list.

exclude_slugs.description: Do not move items whose local slug is in this list.

dimensions.description: Dimensions app folder reconciliation. Unmanaged Dimensions folders are preserved.

enabled.description: Apply Dimensions folder configuration when true.

folders.description: Folders to add or update in the Dimensions app configuration, resolved by full slug.

dimensionFolder.description: Folder configured as a Dimensions root folder.

slug.description: Full slug of an existing or previously ensured folder.

ai_translation_code.description: AI translation language code for this Dimensions folder. Existing values change only when this property is declared.

assets.description: Local asset directory upload configuration. Existing assets are preserved.

upload_directory.description: Local directories whose matching files should be uploaded.

assetUploadDirectory.description: Uploads files from one local directory into a Storyblok asset folder.

source.description: Local directory path. Relative paths are resolved from the directory containing the YAML or JSON setup file.

target_folder.description: Storyblok asset folder path to create or reuse, for example Brand or Products/Shoes.

recursive.description: Discover files in nested local directories and preserve their directory structure below target_folder.

include.description: Optional filename or relative-path glob patterns. When omitted, every discovered file is included.

on_existing.description: Behavior when the target asset folder already contains the same filename. Only skip is currently supported.

fields.description: Fields to create or update on existing components.

componentField.description: Desired field on an existing Storyblok component. Existing fields update only explicitly declared properties.

component.description: Technical name of the existing component containing the field.

type.description: Storyblok field type, such as text, richtext, asset, bloks, custom, or plugin.

field_type.description: Plugin or custom field type, for example sb-ai-seo.

tab.description: Tab display name. Defaults to General when creating a field; existing fields move only when this property is declared.

required.description: Mark the field as required. Defaults to false when creating a field; existing fields change only when declared.

translatable.description: Mark the field as translatable. Defaults to false when creating a field; existing fields change only when declared.

tagAssignments.description: Tag assignment groups. Requested tags are merged with existing story tags.

items.description: Assigns tags to stories selected by ID or slug.

stories.description: Stories to tag. At least one of ids or slugs is required.

ids.description: Story IDs to receive the configured tags.

slugs.description: Story slugs to receive the configured tags.

tags.description: Tags to merge into every selected story.
